name: histogramdd
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::histogramdd(Tensor self, int[] bins, float[]? range=None, Tensor? weight=None, bool density=False) -> (Tensor hist, Tensor[] bin_edges). Computes a multidimensional histogram and generated bin-edge tensors without mutation or aliasing. Tests also cover the stable int_bins and TensorList_bins public overloads, explicit and automatic ranges, weights, density normalization, empty and degenerate inputs, noncontiguous input, metadata, input non-mutation, and invalid bin dimensionality.
